title: Add note
purpose: Add a note to a request's timeline at any stage.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators, in any status. Notes never change the request and cannot be edited or deleted. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Note
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Add note adds the note to the timeline with your name and the time and returns to the timeline.
